note_tweet.text:
i am glad to publish my new app on the fdroid.

https://t.co/eMy4YZGYdQ

It has been quite a journey getting here, and I’m genuinely excited to finally see it live on the F-Droid platform. Bringing proper multilingual support to the project took far more time and effort than I initially expected, especially when it came to translating hundreds of entries, interface elements, and making everything feel natural for Chinese users. With the help of powerful AI tools along the way, we managed to cover almost everything, while still keeping the original spirit of the app intact. 

Now that the latest release is officially available through F-Droid, anyone can install and receive updates directly and securely without any extra hassle. This feels like a real milestone for the project, and I’m grateful for everyone who tested early builds, reported issues, and offered feedback during the development process. The community’s support has made a huge difference. 

I hope this version reaches more people who will find it useful in their own way. Feel free to try it out, share your thoughts, or open an issue if you run into anything. Thank you all for being part of this—here’s to many more updates ahead!
